definition: Something the corpus asks for and does not hold: a photograph nobody has sourced yet, or an ancestor a lineage names and has not recorded. It is drawn in lines falling to the right, and it marks a gap, never a failure.
basis: workbench/app/src/theme/tokens.css, the duty block's comment on this mark: "Wanted: lines falling to the right, for something the corpus asks for and does not hold." It stands among "The marks that are not a verdict, and so never borrow a verdict's form", and the block states the rule every mark keeps: "Each duty token below means one thing wherever it is drawn".
